# Swisscoast AG

> Swiss technology company headquartered in Pfäffikon SZ, Switzerland. Founded in 2003 as Scenic Swisscoast GmbH (UID CHE-110.173.134); converted to Swisscoast AG in 2024. Serves universities, enterprises, DLT economies and foundations worldwide with advisory, software engineering, distributed ledger technology and research.
